guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice exhibits the highest anomaly scores with a +913% latency-90 spike and +607% CPU increase, consistently appearing in the critical path of all traced slow requests. The runbook confirms that exceeding socket/conntrack limits causes connection drops and severe latency degradation, aligning with the observed +49.7% socket metric increase.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the node conntrack/socket limits and scale out productcatalogservice replicas to handle the connection surge and prevent drops.
